decision.reason: [ev-e7cf2f463686] presents this as a new feature: templating of ServiceAccount annotations by running Helm `tpl` on keys and values. It does not say what happens to existing annotation values. It also does not say whether `tpl` always runs or only when enabled, or which chart values paths it covers. The proposed behavior-change says existing literal `{{ ... }}` text will now be rendered, but that comes from general Helm knowledge, not from the evidence, so "none" (an additive feature) is just as consistent with the text. To decide, we need the chart template diff from PR #7501 or the chart's values documentation, showing whether `tpl` is applied unconditionally to existing annotation values and on which values keys.
